questions.question: Which Django URL/viewset/serializer/model paths define the canonical Work Items API?
questions.resolution: The canonical API is routed through work_item.py and implemented by issue views, serializers, and the Issue database model.

questions.question: Which apps/packages own Work Items routes, stores, and UI components?
questions.resolution: The web app owns the primary service and stores while shared issue types live in packages/types.
